name: Underwriting and pricing with AI
blurb: What an insurer may use to price or accept a risk when the model can infer far more than the application asks.

points.desc: Colorado SB 21-169 (2021) prohibits insurers from using external consumer data, algorithms or predictive models in a way that unfairly discriminates on race, color, national origin, religion, sex, sexual orientation, disability, gender identity or gender expression, and the Division of Insurance has issued governance and testing regulations under it, starting with life insurance.
points.name: Colorado's rule on external data

points.desc: The Genetic Information Nondiscrimination Act of 2008 bars health insurers from using genetic information in eligibility or premiums; it does not cover life, disability or long term care insurance, which is where AI-inferred risk is now the live question.
points.name: Genetic information

summary: What an insurer may use to price or accept a risk when the model can infer far more than the application asks.
